coverage: Every Town Meeting the archive finds, 7 May 2011 to 17 November 2026: 31 held, 1 upcoming, 1 called with no later record, and 4 more whose votes the Clerk printed with no date (FY2011, FY2012, FY2013) — 719 articles in all.

Results: 483 from the Town Clerk's printed record in the annual town reports FY2011-FY2025; 75 from our reading of the meeting video (may be unreliable), where we do not have the Clerk's record of the article; 161 whose result we have not found — each says why.
Nothing before 7 May 2011: the archive holds no annual town report before FY2011, so earlier votes are not here.

fy_rule: Fiscal years run 1 July to 30 June. A meeting is filed under the fiscal year it was HELD in: the May Annual Town Meeting falls in the year before the budget it adopts. Where an article names a fiscal year, that is shown beside it.
grain: One row per warrant article per meeting. A row is an ARTICLE, not a motion: an amendment voted on the floor is folded into the article it amended. Dollar amounts are as the warrant or the Clerk printed them; an amount is what was asked or voted, never what was spent.
